question: ISRO'S communication satellite GSAT-29 carried a high resolution camera named as ______ that is capable of tracking enemy ships in the Indian Ocean.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Geo Eye**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Geo Eye** is the high-resolution camera onboard ISRO's communication satellite GSAT-29.
 
• It is capable of tracking enemy ships in the Indian Ocean, providing crucial surveillance data.
 
• GSAT-29 was launched to improve communication and strategic capabilities.
 
• The satellite also aims to provide high-speed internet connectivity to remote and rural areas.
 
• GSAT-29's advanced payloads include Q/V-band communication and optical communication for enhanced data transmission.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **ISRO** (Indian Space Research Organisation) launched GSAT-29 on November 14, 2018, using the GSLV Mk III-D2 vehicle.
 
• This mission marked the second developmental flight of GSLV Mk III, demonstrating its capability to carry heavier payloads into geostationary transfer orbit.
 
• The satellite's mission life is estimated to be over 10 years, ensuring long-term benefits for communication and surveillance.
 
• GSAT-29's success contributes to India's growing prowess in space technology and strategic defense capabilities.
 
• ISRO continues to play a pivotal role in enhancing India's space-based assets for national security and development.
